question: Should OpenClaw remove these shipped bundled skills now, and if so must upgrades automatically migrate their persisted references before Sherpa and the remaining skills move to ClawHub?
rationale: The code cannot safely choose whether silent capability removal is acceptable, which names receive migrations, or whether Sherpa’s ClawHub and native-artifact trust boundary is approved for an official release.

options.title: Require migration before removal
options.body: Keep the trim but add doctor-backed, tested migration for shipped skill references and approve the exact Sherpa package and artifact path before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa from trimming
options.body: Land a narrower Sherpa packaging PR after trust approval while retaining the current bundled starter set until migration policy is settled.

options.title: Accept the compatibility break
options.body: Intentionally remove the skills without migration and own the resulting manual ClawHub installation and support burden as release policy.

recommendation.title: Require migration before removal
recommendation.body: Keep the trim but add doctor-backed, tested migration for shipped skill references and approve the exact Sherpa package and artifact path before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the merged split-work context, is assigned here, and has defined the remaining product boundary in the discussion.
